description: This Java source file defines the PlanetAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter used in an Android navigation drawer. It manages a dataset of planet names and handles item click events within the drawer menu.

classes.name: PlanetAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass that binds a dataset of planet names to views in a navigation drawer.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: A static inner class that holds a reference to the TextView representing a single item in the list.

classes.name: OnItemClickListener
classes.description: An interface to handle click events on drawer items.

methods.name: PlanetAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dataset and click listener.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder containing the inflated item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the given ViewHolder and sets up the click listener for the item.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the dataset.
